pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding allowed within 30 pips of a prior failed trade; consecutive entries must be spaced by a minimum ATR volatility threshold.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory structural rejection of liquidity wicks: entries are blocked if the asset has moved more than 1.5 ATR in the last 3 candles without a volume confirmation node.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressive trailing activation once floating profit hits +$8.00 to lock in wins and systematically prevent degradation into sub-$1 closures.
